content.title: Equestrian Facilities
content.summary: Arvada provides a variety of equestrian facilities, including the 50-acre Indiana Equestrian Center, which is open to the public, and the privately operated Arvada Indoor Equestrian Center that features an all-weather riding arena and educational classes. Additionally, the Horse Protection League, an equine rehabilitation center, is located at the Churches Ranch National Historic District in west Arvada.
content.body:
Arvada offers extensive opportunities for the equestrian community, including several [equestrian use trails](/560) located throughout the community. Arvada is also home to the Indiana Equestrian Center, the Arvada Indoor Equestrian Center and the Horse Protection League.

## Indiana Equestrian Center

The Outdoor Equestrian Center includes 50 acres of riding areas free and open to the public.

### Location

- Street Address:  
  7500 Indiana Street  
  Arvada, CO 80007
- [View on Outdoor Equestrian Center on Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qNktAgPkfcpMzkh9A)
- [Arvada Area Horsemen Association Events](https://www.arvadaareahorsemensassn.org/events)

## Arvada Indoor Equestrian Center

The [Arvada Indoor Equestrian Center](https://www.arvadaindoorequestriancenter.com/) is a privately operated center offering an all-weather indoor riding arena, public hours of operation, and equestrian education classes.

### Contact & Location

- Main Telephone Number: 720-394-0191
- [Email the Indoor Equestrian Center](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c485b6b2a5a0a5adaaa0ababb6a1b5b1a1b7b0b6ada5aaa7a1aab0a1b684a3a9a5ada8eaa7aba9)
- Street Address:  
  7650 Indiana Street  
  Arvada, CO 80007
- [View the Indoor Equestrian Center on Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place/7650+Indiana+St,+Arvada,+CO+80007/@39.83514,-105.162775,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m2!3m1!1s0x876b8f029757d029:0x2154a02bc1d5c054)

## Additional Information

Arvada is also home to the [Horse Protection League](https://www.thehorseprotectionleague.org/), an equine rehabilitation center located at the City-owned Churches Ranch National Historic District in west Arvada.
